traceability.notes: All functional requirements and acceptance criteria for 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are implemented and verified. The `traceability/valid-story-reference` rule exists, is registered in the plugin, and enforces that @story annotations point to existing .story.md files while preventing path traversal and out-of-project access. Path resolution uses `context.cwd` (falling back to process.cwd) plus configurable `storyDirectories`, and absolute path usage is controllable via `allowAbsolutePaths`. Filesystem operations are wrapped with robust error handling and a cached existence layer, delivering both performance and safety. Clear, specific diagnostics (`fileMissing`, `invalidExtension`, `invalidPath`, `fileAccessError`) match the story’s user experience and error-handling requirements, with extensive Jest and RuleTester coverage validating normal, error, boundary, configuration, and security scenarios. Documentation for the rule (docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md and README.md) describes behavior, configuration, and examples consistent with the story. On this basis, the story is fully implemented and passes.
